results.note: All values match Tables 4 and 5; the quality criteria follow the Table 5 footnote, while the Methods add smoking control. The both-biases stratum (0.91) nearly equals the bias-free one (0.90), which tempers the claim's shrinking-difference reading.

Confirmed from the text. The Figure (on my blind-round screenshot) also removes two covariate sets and all covariates; 11 of 15 single removals give 0.90 to 0.92 with P < .05, so the non-significance depends on the full set.

All nine estimates and the closing sentence match Tables 4 and 5; role fits. Table 5 values are adjusted only for sampling and between-study variation. Without Friesema, 25 to under 45 g was also significantly raised (1.29).

Numbers and editors' calculation (0.613) confirmed; the edited 'incidence' gloss now matches the paper's own definition (Average alcohol consumption, 3rd paragraph). Figure 2, read on screen in the blind round, plots the whiskers near 0.50 and 0.78.
